summary: Destroys every node of a linked list by calling each node's vtable destructor with argument 1, advancing through nodes via the next-node link at node offset 0x8C. Then resets list controller state: head (this+0x90) to 0, item count (this+0x94) to 0, selection (this+0x168) to -1. Finally invokes a vtable method at offset 0x2C on this with argument 1 and returns its result.

operations.description: Load linked-list head pointer from this+0x90 into traversal variable.
Continue traversal while current node pointer is non-null.
Advance traversal to next node via next-node link at node offset 0x8C.
Call current node's vtable destructor (function pointer at node offset 0x0) with (node, 1).
Load vtable pointer of this from this+0x0.
Call vtable method at offset 0x2C on this with argument 1 and return its result.

unresolved: Semantics of the final vtable method at offset 0x2C (notification/refresh) and of the destructor argument 1 are not grounded by the packet.
The next-node field is attributed by the packet to base *(this+0x11C) while raw source traverses from this+0x90; the base-object relationship is unresolved.
Ordering: head, selection, then count are reset (source order); whether order is semantically meaningful is unknown.
